site_name: The Change Of Hart Public House, 21 High Street,
decision_conditions: <div><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">The works hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this consent.</span></span></div><div><p><br></p></div>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">Suitable precautions shall be taken to secure and protect features against accidental loss or damage during the building work hereby granted, and no such features may be disturbed or removed, temporarily or permanently, except as indicated on the approved drawings or with the prior approval in writing of the local planning authority.<br></span></span><br></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">If previously unknown evidence is discovered about historic character which would be affected by the works hereby granted, an appropriate record, together with recommendations for dealing with it in the context of the scheme, shall be approved in writing by the local planning authority before any of the permitted works are begun. The works shall be completed in accordance with the approved details.</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">All new external and internal works and finishes and works of making good to the retained fabric shall match the existing adjacent work with regard to the methods used and to material, colour, texture and profile, unless shown otherwise on the drawings or other documentation hereby approved or required by any conditions(s) attached to this consent.<br><br></span></span></p>

<div style="text-align:justify"><div><p><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif"><span style="font-size:12pt">Notwithstanding the plans hereby approved, prior to installation of any new services, details of the routing of all pipework, ductwork, ventilation, cabling, boxing, service risers and any associated fixings if this is to go <span style="font-size:12pt">through the historic fabric shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved details shall thereafter be implemented only as approved.</span></span></span></p></div></div><div style="text-align:justify"><p><br></p></div>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">Details for the following (including samples being made available on site) shall be provided to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the relevant part of the works:</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">a) </span></span><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">Doors</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">b) Secondary glazing</span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">c) Paint (including where this will go)</span></span></p><p><br></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">No more than 40% of the existing roof tiles on any individual roof slope shall be replaced unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority, following submission of a detailed roof condition survey demonstrating why a greater level of replacement is necessary.</span></span></p><p><br></p>

<div><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif"><span style="line-height:115%">Restricted Lighting</span></span></span></div><div><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">No external lighting shall be installed on the development hereby permitted unless full details of a lighting scheme are submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall include details of the exact location, height, design, and intensity of the lights, and shall be designed to prevent light spillage onto nearby habitat suitable for bats. The lighting shall be installed and operated strictly in accordance with the approved details.</span></span></p></div>
<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">All works shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved Biodiversity Enhancement Plan.</span></span></p>
description: Listed Building Consent: Internal and external alterations at ground, first, second floor and roof level in association with the re-use of the building as a public house and ancillary accommodation including fabric repairs, retiling of roof, internal reordering including creation of en-suites for guest rooms, provision of new floor, wall and ceiling finishes, installation of new services, and formation of a new plant room, removal and introduction of walls, secondary glazing, fire doors, staircase alterations, fire and sound insulation, installing a kitchen at ground floor level (Amended description)
